content.text:
Ashby did return that role. We dropped it in the title filter.

The posting is on the `salmon-group` board:

`Software Engineer (Internal Tools & HR Automation)` — primary location Georgia, remote, plus secondary offices including **Yerevan / Armenia**.

After the Ashby fetch we kept 4 of 148 jobs. This one never made that list because `is_relevant()` treats `" hr "` as an exclude keyword. The title contains ` & HR Automation`, so it is classified as an HR role even though it also matches `software engineer`.

That exclude is doing the wrong job here. It is meant to drop recruiters and HR managers; substring `" hr "` also hits engineering titles that mention HR systems.

If we relaxed the title gate, we would still likely drop it today. `parse_ashby_api_jobs` only keeps the primary `location` (`Georgia`) and ignores `secondaryLocations`. The company is tagged `Yerevan`, which only appears in the secondary list.

So this is not an Ashby fetch miss. It is a filter miss, with a parser gap behind it.

I would fix two things, in this order:

1. **Title gate** — do not apply the `" hr "` exclude when the title already matched engineer/developer (same exception you already have for marketing), or replace it with tighter phrases like `hr manager` / `human resource`.
2. **Ashby listings** — pass `secondaryLocations` into the job so Yerevan is visible to the location filter.

content.text:
Right — Ashby returned it, and the fetch then threw it away. That’s why it never showed up with the other four.

Two filters hit it:

1. **Title** — `" hr "` in the exclude list matched `HR Automation`, so it never counted as an engineering role.
2. **Location** — Ashby only kept primary `Georgia`. The Yerevan/Armenia offices are in `secondaryLocations`. Salmon is tagged Yerevan, so Georgia-only failed the office gate.

That’s fixed now. Engineer titles no longer drop on a bare `"hr"` substring, Ashby listings include secondary offices, and a job is kept if **any** listed office matches the company tag.

Re-fetch Salmon. `Software Engineer (Internal Tools & HR Automation)` should land with the other matching roles.
